The name Balharsh carries the meaning “Brave Lord” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Balharsh usually hope their child will grow to embody brave lord and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: Balharshah was a Hindu king of the Kakatiya Dynasty who ruled from 1356 to 1385 CE. He is most famous for his military conquests, which expanded the Kakatiya Empire to its greatest extent. He defeated the Tamil Cholas, the Reddis, and the Muslims, and is considered one of the greatest rulers of the Kakatiya Dynasty.
